dialog.openFolder: Choose a project folder to add to Trellis

quit.title: Claude is still running
quit.detail: Quitting now ends {{count}} running Claude session(s). The conversation stays in Claude Code, so you can continue it later.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Trellis
onboarding.subtitle: Keep the intent of your project in view while you work with AI.
onboarding.languageHint: Used for the app. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.claudeHelp: Install Claude Code, then check again. If it is installed but not found, set its path in Settings → Claude Code after you start.
onboarding.gitHelp: Trellis needs git to track changes. Install git, then check again.
onboarding.shellEnvWarn: Could not read your login shell environment. Some commands may not be found.
onboarding.projectHint: Add a folder you want to work on with Claude. You can also skip this and add one later.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyHint: Add a folder you want to work on with Claude.
projects.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from the list? The files in the folder stay where they are.

terminal.noProjectBody: Pick a project on the left or add a folder, and Claude Code starts here.
terminal.notFoundBody: Make sure Claude Code is installed. If it is and still not found, set its path in Settings.
terminal.startBody: Continue your last conversation or start a new one.

intent.title: Intent
intent.empty: Before you start, write down what you want to do and what must not break. Later it answers "why did we do this?"
intent.placeholder:
Goal: lock an account for 30 minutes after 5 failed logins
Must not: change the existing session token format
Expected impact: auth, members
intent.hint: Write it yourself, briefly — that is the point. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter saves.
intent.noClaude: No running Claude session to paste into. Your intent was saved.

inspector.noProject: Open a project to see its intent, timeline, changes, decisions and health here.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.emptyHint: Ask Claude for something in the terminal and each request shows up here as a turn.

changes.title: Changes
changes.fallback: No baseline for this run, so this compares against the last commit.
changes.emptyHead: Nothing changed since the last commit.
changes.notRepoHint: Trellis computes changes with git. Start git in this folder to track them.
changes.gitMissing: git was not found. Install git and try again.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.disabled: Decisions are turned off for this project
decisions.missing: The decisions folder ({{dir}}) does not exist
decisions.missingHint: One short markdown file per decision. If this project keeps decisions elsewhere, change the folder in Settings.
decisions.upcoming: Next version: when a turn ends, Trellis detects new decisions, asks you why, and records your answer here.

health.title: Health
health.truncated: Too many files; only part of the project was measured.
health.upcoming: Next version: structure rules, baselines, and what got worse since last week.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsHint: Notify when Claude finishes or waits for you while Trellis is in the background.
settings.dataNote: Settings, the project list and event records are stored only on this computer.
settings.claudePathHint: Leave empty to search PATH and the default install locations.
settings.extraArgsHint: Added when launching claude. Example: --model opus
settings.defaultModeHint: Starts a new conversation when there is nothing to continue.
settings.autoStartHint: Launch Claude Code as soon as you pick a project.
settings.editorKindHint: Trellis has no editor of its own; files open in the editor you choose here.
settings.customPathHint: The file path is passed as the first argument.
settings.fontFamilyHint: Leave empty for the default monospace font.
settings.decisionsDirHint: Relative to the project. Leave empty to turn the decisions panel off — do that if the project already records decisions another way, so they are not kept twice.
settings.recordLanguageHint: Language for records Trellis writes into this project.

toast.gitInitFailed: Could not create a git repository. {{message}}
